title: Rewrite unified settings surface
goal: Rewrite settings as one unified surface from EnhancedSettingsRouter + legacy account-settings families

Redirect the legacy standalone settings URLs into the unified surface.

evidence: Scoped tsc over app/api/profile/**, app/api/settings/**, lib/seo/**, lib/profile/**: 36 primary diagnostics before, 21 after, 0 new. The 15 removed are exactly 10 profiles.custom_url errors in lib/seo/public-preview-readers.ts, 1 calculate_venue_profile_completion error in app/api/settings/route.ts, and 4 in app/api/profile/[username]/route.ts.

The re-derivation contradicts docs/engineering/database-type-inventory-2026-09-25.json. The inventory attributes profiles.custom_url to lib/public-artist/get-public-artist-profile.ts, which contains no such reference at HEAD or in the worktree, and claims 17 hits; the measured count is 10 and every one is in lib/seo/public-preview-readers.ts. It also attributes calculate_venue_profile_completion to three files and records 8 hits; the measured reality is one live consumer, app/api/settings/route.ts:125, confirmed independently by rg excluding docs/ and by the discover lane.

The 21 remaining scoped diagnostics are not general-user's: 15 are venue_profiles.cover_image_url, already resolved by the unapplied-but-committed supabase/migrations/20260925210000_venue_profile_presentation_columns.sql that names lib/seo/public-preview-readers.ts as its reader, and 6 are in lib/services/optimized-notification-service.ts (design-system's grant).

Runtime consequence, larger than the diagnostic count: a PostgREST statement naming a column the relation does not expose returns an error and a null data, so one phantom identifier disables the whole statement. profiles.custom_url was inside the select of app/api/profile/current/route.ts (9 entry-reachable callers), inside both selects of app/api/profile/[username]/route.ts, and inside the update payload of app/api/profile/update/route.ts (a form that always submits the field). app/api/profile/update-optimized/route.ts copied every submitted key into the column payload, so the `phone` both settings forms always send poisoned the statement and the settings profile form could not save at all. profiles.verified in app/api/settings/profile/route.ts was the same shape. All are repointed; none was made more permissive.

Authorization: app/api/settings/route.ts accepted a caller-supplied profile_id on both verbs. RLS blocked the cross-user write but the route answered success:true for a zero-row update, and RLS never blocked the cross-user read because profiles_select is USING (true) in the active chain. Both verbs now return 403 and issue no query; 5 route tests cover it.

Focused vitest: 32 files / 205 tests passed across __tests__/auth, __tests__/profile, __tests__/settings, __tests__/seo, __tests__/uploads, __tests__/security, __tests__/onboarding, __tests__/general, __tests__/dashboard. The two new files are 23 tests.
Focused eslint exit 0 with no output. git diff --check scoped to the general-user paths exit 0.

npm run check:migration-chain PASS (306 files scanned), check:migration-validation PASS, check:public-surface PASS, check:db002-security-contract PASS, check:service-role-allowlist PASS, security exception registry OK (3 active entries).

npm run agents:validate: 17 agents, 152 tasks, 0 errors, 8 warnings. All 8 warnings are `generated from a different SHA`; agents:generate is forbidden this wave, so the shared-map refresh belongs to the orchestrator.

NOT RUN and not claimed: no full `npm run typecheck` (68m18s on CI, OOMs on this 8GB machine with six concurrent lanes), no full test suite, no migration apply, no `supabase db reset` (CP-051), no hosted or credentialed action, no CodeQL re-analysis. All QA-004 campaign coverage rows remain not_run; no staging target exists.

Repointed every profiles.custom_url column use in the grant to the canonical profiles.username handle; custom_url survives only as a documented request/response alias so the existing settings forms keep working.

Routed profiles.phone to profiles.profile_data.phone in the update routes, which is the storage the public gate actually strips.

Fixed the undeclared baseSocialLinks spread in app/api/profile/[username]/route.ts, which threw a ReferenceError at runtime, and gave lib/profile/general-public-profile.ts an explicit return type so the gate's output is usable at the call site.
